query:
SELECT c.id
        FROM agent_capabilities c
        WHERE c.id = ANY($1::uuid[])
          AND c.agent_id = $2
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM relay_invocations i
              WHERE i.grantee_agent_id = $3
                AND i.capability_id = c.id
                AND i.status <> 'rejected'
          )
